defectFound.status: FIXED — a position with no starting slot gets vbd null, as it should. This block is now a regression guard: the numbers below are all null/0 BECAUSE the bug is gone, not because the measurement failed.
defectFound.league: 12 teams, QB/2RB/2WR/TE/2FLEX, no K and no DEF slot — the user's own Sofahetjur league as sleeper-league.js reads it
defectFound.rootCause: src/model.js computeVbd: `const r = repl[pos] || list.length`. Zero is a REAL value (the league starts none of that position) but `||` reads it as missing and falls back to the pool floor, so the baseline becomes the worst player at the position instead of a level that reflects zero starting slots.
defectFound.whyItWasInvisible: build.js excludes K and DST from aRank via RANKED_POS, so the A-Ranking ORDER is clean. The bad number reaches the vbd column for K/DST and, through tierize(withVbd.map(r => r.vbd)), the cross-position tier of real players.

mostConsistent.note: cells are NOT independent (same seasons, same pool) — a direction, not a sign test

verdict: NOTHING BEATS THE CURRENT VBD BASELINE AT THE BAR THIS REPO USES. 144 variant x shape x scoring cells were measured as a paired head-to-head draft in the same league, and not one variant clears a positive mean plus BOTH the season-clustered and the player-clustered 95% interval. With 144 comparisons the best cell is expected to look positive by chance alone; a Bonferroni-corrected bar would need roughly 144 times the evidence, and nothing here is close to that. Most consistent direction: "flexpool-mid" is positive in 9 of 9 cells (mean of cell means +53.9 points, significant in 1). The cells are NOT independent — same seasons, same pool, correlated players — so this is a direction, not a sign test. Is the best baseline different in PPR and half-PPR? The raw-search leader is the same variant in 2 of 3 shapes (12-2flex, 12-std), and the paired per-season PPR-minus-half difference is significant for 1 of 16 variants: 10-2flex|ppr-half|flexpool-te (39.8, t=2.833) — read those as multiplicity before reading them as a scoring effect. The receptions-compress-RB-and-WR argument is real in the numbers (the measured startable ranks move by 1-3 seats between PPR and half) but it does not move the DECISION far enough to justify a separate baseline per scoring. Read the walk-forward row before wiring anything: variant selection is exactly where arank-lab already found noise (+109 raw versus +46 walk-forward).
